results.title: Realtime accepts a WebSocket upgrade carrying a foreign Origin
results.detail: wss /realtime/v1/websocket with the anon key. No Origin -> opened true, heartbeat answered true, closed 1000. Origin https://attacker.example -> opened true, heartbeat answered true, closed 1000. A socket that opens and answers under a foreign Origin means the hosted endpoint does not enforce check_origin; the anon key and RLS remain the gate.
